name: Provision sweep
description: Every ten minutes: a project whose container setup never finished — a tenant row with no domain, more than an hour old, whose setup log has stopped moving — is removed through the one delete there is (archived, container/origin/workspace/proxy/row gone), its hung setup process ended first, and its owner sent a Note saying where it stopped. Core only: it reads the instance table. scripts/provision-sweep.php has the reasoning.
